create_flat_torus_manifold: create a FlatTorus01 manifold instance with a given ndim for Riemannian optimization on a flat torus
use_expmap_logmap: use FlatTorus01 expmap and logmap to compute geodesic transport and logarithmic mapping on the torus
create_masked_no_drift_torus: create a MaskedNoDriftFlatTorus01 manifold that fixes the first atom to the origin and removes drift velocity
use_proju_remove_drift: use MaskedNoDriftFlatTorus01 proju to remove mean drift velocity from tangent vectors on the manifold
create_wrapped_normal_torus: create a FlatTorus01FixFirstAtomToOriginWrappedNormal manifold that samples wrapped normal random points with a given scale
